INDEMNIFICATION CLAUSE REVIEW PACKET

The following three indemnification provisions are drawn from three separate freelance services agreements, each between a Client and a Contractor, reproduced here as standalone clauses for review.

CLAUSE A: Greenfield Manufacturing Co. Master Services Agreement, Section 9

9.1 Contractor shall indemnify, defend, and hold harmless Client, its affiliates, officers, and employees from any and all third-party claims, losses, damages, and expenses, including attorneys' fees, arising out of or in connection with Contractor's performance under this Agreement, without limitation as to amount.

9.2 Client shall have no corresponding obligation to indemnify Contractor for any claim, loss, damage, or expense arising out of or in connection with this Agreement.

CLAUSE B: Riverbend Analytics Consulting Agreement, Section 11

11.1 Contractor shall indemnify, defend, and hold harmless Client from third-party claims arising out of Contractor's gross negligence or willful misconduct in performing the Services, provided that Contractor's total indemnification liability under this Section 11 shall not exceed fifteen thousand dollars ($15,000) in the aggregate.

11.2 Client shall have no obligation to indemnify Contractor for any claim, loss, damage, or expense arising out of or in connection with this Agreement, and no cap of any kind applies to limit Client's own liability elsewhere in this Agreement.

CLAUSE C: Tidewater Creative Studio Agreement, Section 6

6.1 Each party shall indemnify, defend, and hold harmless the other party from third-party claims, losses, damages, and expenses arising out of the indemnifying party's gross negligence, willful misconduct, or material breach of this Agreement.

6.2 Each party's obligation to indemnify the other under this Section 6 shall not exceed the total fees paid or payable under this Agreement, and this cap and indemnification obligation apply equally and reciprocally to both Client and Contractor.
